verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Runway is a generative video platform, but nothing in the evidence documents turning a pasted script into a rendered presenter-led avatar video. The 'Characters: Avatars' feature is described as real-time conversational sessions with knowledge bases, tool calling and an embedded widget, which is an adjacent interactive-agent capability rather than scripted presenter video. Generic text-to-video and voice cloning are building blocks, not this capability.
